2.source_text: The Lord God of Israel hath sent his angel with this message to the children of men; “to them that dwell upon the earth, and to every nation, and kindred, and tongue, and people, saying, with a loud voice, fear God and give glory to him: for the hour of his judgments is I come, and worship him that made Heav eo, and earth, and the sea, and the fountains of waters.
